purpose: Separate money surface forms from context-based monetary role prediction while retaining original values and offsets.
status: Designed after observing v3 failures. Existing evaluation and official passages are known development data; combined perturbation is new but derived from the same authored grammar. Not a blind or independent linguistic test.
authoring: Personal soccz follow-up; AI-assisted design, code, synthetic data and provisional labels; independent human reviews completed: 0.

conditions.raw: Reuse three v3 fit evidence models; original training960
conditions.raw_scope: Reuse three v3 scope-augmentation evidence models; scope training960
conditions.normalized: Three new fits; original training960; every parsed amount replaced with 0원
conditions.normalized_scope: Three new fits; scope training960; every parsed amount replaced with 0원

model: v3 evidence reader, upper two encoder layers and heads trainable, unchanged losses. CUDA fp16 training with overflow skips recorded; fp32 inference. Last epoch, no checkpoint selection.
inputs: Only query and passage determine model features. Gold labels used only for supervised loss/evaluation. Original parser values/offsets kept outside encoder; predicted roles and evidence remapped to source characters.
hypotheses: Within parser-supported value-preserving rewrites, normalized input tokens are identical; consequently predictions should match. This is invariance imposed by representation, not learned numeric reasoning.
Scope-augmented training may reduce distraction, but gains under the joint perturbation and on official passages are not assumed.
Normalization hides value distinctions from the encoder. Retaining parsed numbers permits a separate numeric decoder, but does not restore all quantitative reasoning.
evaluation: validation-selected coverage and risk by class
decoders: v3 numeric: suppress restatement only for model-selected unique before/after values that differ; never supply gold roles
gate: v3 threshold 0.00..0.99, at least20 validation answers with joint error<=5%, choose maximum coverage. If none, answer none. No evaluation tuning.
paired_uncertainty: For combined-probe normalized_scope minus raw_scope, report paired frame bootstrap of mean-over-seed joint correctness, 6 frame clusters, 10000 replicates seed1729. Conditional synthetic variability, not population confidence.

display_example.reason: Fixed first evaluation case before v4 inference, not selected for success.

stop: Six new fits, six existing-model inference audits, both decoders, all seeds and failures retained. No result-dependent extra fitting in this round.
limits: Arabic-number Korean won parser only; unsupported forms/signs may be incomplete. No new human gold, agency/event holdout, document-version collection, speaker/negation-scope solution, or novelty/generalization claim.
